en.title: Minimum Total Cost of Buying Books from Both Ends with a Pair Discount
en.description:
At each step you may buy the leftmost or the rightmost remaining book at its original price, or buy the two different books at both ends together for pairCost. Joint purchases can be made at most k times. Find the minimum cost to buy all the books.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n pairCost k; the second line contains the prices. 1≤n≤100000, 1≤price,pairCost≤10^9, 1≤k≤n.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 3, 3 and 3. In the second example the two 100s at the ends are bought together; when the discount does not pay off, you may skip it.
hints: Sort the prices and enumerate the number of joint purchases j, using them on the 2j most expensive books; the cost is the total price minus the sum of the 2j most expensive books plus j times pairCost.
